description: This source file defines a Java interface 'DeleteThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder' that provides methods for building responses and events related to the 'DeleteThing' command in the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies nested interfaces for response and event factory methods used during command execution.

classes.name: DeleteThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface to build responses and events for DeleteThing commands, extending the base modify command response steps.

classes.name: ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command response objects related to DeleteThing, including success and error cases.

classes.name: EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event objects triggered by the DeleteThing command, notably the 'deleted' event.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Builds a 'DeleteThingResponse' or 'ThingDeleted' event using the values of the DeleteThing command.

methods.name: thingNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates a 'ThingErrorResponse' indicating the 'Thing' was not accessible, associated with 'ThingNotAccessibleException'.

methods.name: thingNotDeletableError
methods.description: Creates a 'ThingErrorResponse' indicating the 'Thing' was not deletable, associated with 'ThingNotDeletableException'.
